paraphrase: Conditional on the affirmative A4P2 report: for any property P that can first be exemplified and can have a bearer with a cause, caused first exemplification of P is possible. The two antecedent possibilities can have different histories and witnesses. The antecedent does not require that the bearer be caused to acquire P; the redness example mentions caused existence of red bearers. The consequent concerns causation of first exemplification, not merely a caused P-bearer after earlier P-instances. This records the reported transfer, not a general theorem combining separate possibilities.
